placement.method: Reversible transform-only relocation of 24 of 48 scan ferns toward six clusters near the two recorded camera positions. Same scale, rotation, mesh and material; actual projected convex hulls of all existing nonterrain nonfern geometry as conservative obstacles; unchanged 5m route buffer, sanctuary and camera reservations. Seed 2026112514. First four-cluster attempt radius 3.4m failed fit; replaced with six seed patches radius 4.5m, 4 instances each, successful. No count increase.

render.method: Same two V13 perspective cameras, same 60deg FOV, base color, UV, depth and alpha. Real geometry directional shadow raster with alpha cutout and orthographic light-depth map; 4096^2, texel 0.04804879299231908m, 25 tap PCF, bias 0.085m. Reconstruct visible world positions from camera depth, apply authored ambient/direct multiplier preserving fog. No shadows baked into GLB.
render.review: Self HOLD: stronger foreground and cast shadow, but uniformly broad dark masses, open skyline, bare ground, repeated tree structures and primitive branches remain. No native Blender or full physically based lighting.

outputs.delivery: Local GLB and QA/reproduction zip; replay script and receipt committed, exact readback. No new Actions execution.

limits: Candidate-only; not official CG. Planar footprint and sampled grounding, not navigation. Shadow preview is CPU diagnostic, no full PBR, indirect illumination, native rendering, actual game integration or Android. No new hero-tree precision work without D4. Prior owners untouched.
next: Prioritize true native render access and deeper forest silhouette / background and ground material differentiation, rather than further unmeasured count increases. Actual old-tree blueprint D4 and independent G2 required. Preserve V13/V14 candidates.
